//exports: SUPERSEDES the note this key carried through sprint 9, which said an installed copy CANNOT run under deno and that main/bin belong elsewhere. That is now false: this package ships COMPILED .js built by prepack, and deno's restriction is on type-STRIPPING under node_modules, not on running .js from there. The published surface is dist/ alone -- src/ is deliberately NOT shipped, so no user can aim a runtime at a .ts entry point under node_modules and hit that error at all. There is still no `main`, no `.` export and no `bin`. The map's three arms and the reason for each, the refusal of `bin`, and why JSR was measured and declined are asserted in test/package-shape.test.ts: package.json cannot carry comments, oxfmt sorts this key to the tail, and a test is the one home for a reason that fails when someone violates it.
